parsed.claim_reason: Greedy picks the least admissible integer, not one with minimal prime support. E.g. from a_1=2 the sequence is 2,4,6,8,10,12,...; a_3=6 has prime set {2,3}, while the proper subset {2} already hits every earlier prime set. Same failure with a_1=3, a_2=6.
parsed.witness_reason: It violates the hypothesis: 9 shares no prime with 8, so a_3=9 is not admissible; the greedy value after 6,8 is 10. The listed triple is not a greedy sequence, hence not a counterexample.
